text: Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant and altruistic scientist driven by a deep personal connection to the disease she seeks to cure, having suffered from it during her youth. Her primary motivation is to alleviate the suffering caused by this illness, a goal that fuels her tireless efforts even when faced with significant personal health setbacks and professional skepticism. This dedication highlights her resilience and her ability to maintain hope and determination against overwhelming odds. As she persists in her research, one might look up at the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, finding a moment of quiet reflection amidst her rigorous scientific pursuits.
